info.description: This is the API server for Banana Project.
info.title: Banana Project Go REST API

get.description: Retrieves all product categories ordered by ID. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

Returns executive KPIs, sales timeline, payment method breakdown, top products, category distribution, purchases vs sales, and inventory stock alerts. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.
Retrieves stored bank receipts, optionally filtered by a received_at date range. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.
Calculates total revenue, transaction counts, average ticket, period-over-period growth, and daily timeline buckets from email receipts. Requires ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid date or date range

post.description: Reads receipt registers from the configured Google Sheets document in chunks and stores new sale details. Requires the ayurami-admin role.
post.summary: Sync bank receipts from Google Sheets

400.description: Bad request: invalid JSON payload or date range

get.description: Retrieves all products ordered alphabetically by name. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

post.description: Creates a new product in the catalog and initializes its inventory to zero. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid JSON payload or missing name

get.description: Retrieves detailed information of a single product. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

put.description: Updates an existing product's fields. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid ID or invalid JSON payload or missing name

delete.description: Deletes a product along with all associated inventory, recipe entries, and allowed additions. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

get.description: Retrieves purchase orders ordered by date descending with optional supplier and date range filtering. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

post.description: Registers a restock invoice, inserts purchase details, atomically increments physical inventory stock, and recalculates product weighted average cost (PMP). Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.
post.summary: Create a new purchase order / restock

400.description: Bad request: invalid payload or validation error

get.description: Retrieves a single purchase header and its associated item line details. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

put.description: Atomically reverts prior line stock and weighted average cost contributions, deletes previous items, updates header metadata, inserts new items, applies new inventory stock increments and recomputes weighted average cost (PMP). Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid payload or validation error

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of sales with optional filtering by date range, payment method, and cashier. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

parameters.description: Filter by payment method (e.g. Cash, Card)
parameters.name: paymentMethod

post.description: Registers a new sale, deducts product or recipe ingredient inventory, and records details. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid JSON payload or sale must have at least one item

get.description: Retrieves full sale ticket details including itemized products and prices. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.
Retrieves all registered suppliers with optional search filtering by company name, tax ID, or contact. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

post.description: Registers a new goods or ingredients provider. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid payload or missing fields

get.description: Retrieves detailed information of a single supplier. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.

put.description: Modifies an existing supplier's details. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

400.description: Bad request: invalid payload or missing fields

delete.description: Deletes a supplier by ID if they have no associated purchases. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

409.description: Conflict: cannot delete supplier with associated purchases

get.description: Retrieves all available units of measure ordered by name. Requires the ayurami-admin or ayurami-salesperson role.
Retrieves all registered users ordered alphabetically by name. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

post.description: Creates a new system user (admin or salesperson) with a secure hashed password. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

get.description: Retrieves detailed user profile information. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

put.description: Updates a user's role, password, fullName, or status. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a user from the system. Requires the ayurami-admin role.

get.description: Returns a simple web page with the centered logo and "hecho en Colombia" footer.
Returns the embedded Ayurami logo image bytes.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

400.description: Bad request: invalid JSON payload or missing username

post.description: Generates a new token pair using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Checks if the API is running and verifies connection to the database.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp when the category was created (Spanish: Creado En).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

name.description: Name is the category name (Spanish: Nombre).

amount.description: Amount is the payment amount (Spanish: Monto).

bank.description: Bank is the originating bank (Spanish: Banco).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the ingestion timestamp (Spanish: Creado En).

currency.description: Currency is the ISO currency code (Spanish: Moneda).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

messageId.description: MessageID is the source email message id; unique and used for idempotent ingestion (Spanish: ID Mensaje).

parseError.description: ParseError holds the parsing failure message when Status is error (Spanish: Error de Parseo).

payer.description: Payer is the person/entity that paid (Spanish: Pagador).

paymentMethod.description: PaymentMethod is the payment method label (e.g. QR Negocios Bre-B) (Spanish: Método de Pago).

receivedAt.description: ReceivedAt is when the inbox received the email (Spanish: Recibido En).

reference.description: Reference is the bank reference code (Spanish: Referencia).

sender.description: Sender is the email sender address (Spanish: Remitente).

status.description: Status is the ingestion status: imported or error (Spanish: Estado).

subject.description: Subject is the email subject line (Spanish: Asunto).

transactionDate.description: TransactionDate is the date/time of the payment as reported in the receipt body (Spanish: Fecha de Transacción).

transactionNumber.description: TransactionNumber is the unique transaction id from the bank (Spanish: Número de Transacción).

averageCost.description: AverageCost is the dynamic weighted cost from purchases (Spanish: Costo Promedio).

categoryId.description: CategoryID is the reference ID of the category (Spanish: ID Categoría).

categoryName.description: CategoryName is the name of the category (Spanish: Nombre Categoría).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the creation timestamp (Spanish: Creado En).

currentStock.description: CurrentStock is the real-time stock from inventories (Spanish: Stock Actual).

description.description: Description is the optional product description (Spanish: Descripción).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

isForSale.description: IsForSale defines if it can be sold in the POS (Spanish: Es Para Venta).

maximumStock.description: MaximumStock is the maximum storage limit from inventories (Spanish: Stock Máximo).

minimumStock.description: MinimumStock is the minimum reorder threshold from inventories (Spanish: Stock Mínimo).

name.description: Name is the commercial name (Spanish: Nombre).

requiresRecipe.description: RequiresRecipe defines if it deducts child recipe items upon sale (Spanish: Requiere Receta).

sellPrice.description: SellPrice is the price for customers, can be 0 for pure ingredients (Spanish: Precio de Venta).

unitAbbreviation.description: UnitAbbreviation is the abbreviation of the unit of measure (Spanish: Abreviatura Unidad).

unitName.description: UnitName is the name of the unit of measure (Spanish: Nombre Unidad).

unitOfMeasureId.description: UnitOfMeasureID is the reference ID of the unit of measure (Spanish: ID Unidad de Medida).

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the last modification timestamp (Spanish: Actualizado En).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the creation timestamp (Spanish: Creado En).

details.description: Details is the list of line items in this purchase (Spanish: Detalles de Compra).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

invoiceNumber.description: InvoiceNumber is the provider's physical invoice ID (Spanish: Número de Factura).

notes.description: Notes is any additional comment or observation (Spanish: Observaciones).

purchaseDate.description: PurchaseDate is when the transaction occurred (Spanish: Fecha de Compra).

supplierId.description: SupplierID is the reference to the supplying company (Spanish: ID Proveedor).

supplierName.description: SupplierName is the company name of the supplier (Spanish: Nombre Proveedor).

totalAmount.description: TotalAmount is the sum paid for the purchase (Spanish: Total de la Compra).

baseQuantity.description: BaseQuantity is the effective quantity added to inventory stock (Spanish: Cantidad Base).

conversionFactor.description: ConversionFactor is the ratio of base units per purchase unit (Spanish: Factor de Conversión).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

productId.description: ProductID is the bought item or ingredient product ID (Spanish: ID Producto).

productName.description: ProductName is the name of the bought product (Spanish: Nombre Producto).

purchaseId.description: PurchaseID is the parent purchase header ID (Spanish: ID Compra).

purchaseUnitId.description: PurchaseUnitID is the unit of measure used in the purchase (Spanish: ID Unidad de Compra).

purchaseUnitName.description: PurchaseUnitName is the name of the purchase unit (Spanish: Unidad de Compra).

quantityPurchased.description: QuantityPurchased is the quantity bought in the purchase unit (Spanish: Cantidad Comprada).

subtotal.description: Subtotal is the total price for this line item (Spanish: Subtotal).

unitCost.description: UnitCost is the net cost paid per unit in this purchase (Spanish: Costo Unitario).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the creation timestamp (Spanish: Creado En).

details.description: Details is the list of line items in this sale (Spanish: Detalles de Venta).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

itemsCount.description: ItemsCount is the total number of distinct line items in the sale (Spanish: Cantidad de Ítems).

paymentMethod.description: PaymentMethod is the checkout method (e.g. Cash, Card) (Spanish: Método de Pago).

saleDate.description: SaleDate is when the checkout occurred (Spanish: Fecha de Venta).

totalAmount.description: TotalAmount is the final total net amount received (Spanish: Total de la Venta).

userId.description: UserID is the reference ID of the cashier who sold it (Spanish: ID Usuario).

userName.description: UserName is the name of the cashier / user who registered the sale (Spanish: Nombre Usuario).

historicalUnitPrice.description: HistoricalUnitPrice is the unit price at the time of sale (Spanish: Precio Unitario Histórico).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

productId.description: ProductID is the principal sold product ID (Spanish: ID Producto).

productName.description: ProductName is the name of the sold product (Spanish: Nombre Producto).

quantity.description: Quantity is the amount sold, supports decimals for weighed items (Spanish: Cantidad).

saleId.description: SaleID is the parent sale header ID (Spanish: ID Venta).

companyName.description: CompanyName is the legal name of the business (Spanish: Razón Social).

contactName.description: ContactName is the provider contact representative (Spanish: Nombre de Contacto).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp when the supplier was registered (Spanish: Creado En).

description.description: Description represents additional notes or details about the supplier (Spanish: Descripción / Notas).

email.description: Email is the contact email address (Spanish: Correo Electrónico).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

phone.description: Phone is the contact number (Spanish: Teléfono).

taxId.description: TaxID is the tax identifier (e.g. NIT/Cédula) (Spanish: NIT o Cédula).

abbreviation.description: Abbreviation is the short code representing the unit (Spanish: Abreviatura).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp when the unit was created (Spanish: Creado En).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

name.description: Name is the name of the unit (Spanish: Nombre).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the registration timestamp (Spanish: Creado En).

fullName.description: FullName is the operator's real name (Spanish: Nombre Completo).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier (Spanish: ID).

isActive.description: IsActive defines if the user account is enabled (Spanish: Activo).

role.description: Role is the authorization role (e.g. Administrator, Cajero) (Spanish: Rol).

username.description: Username is the login identifier (Spanish: Nombre de Usuario).

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer " followed by the JWT obtained from POST /login.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
